learning_outcomes.text: Examines the kinematic and kinetic information of bodies in a dynamic state in linear motion.
Examines the kinematic and kinetic information of bodies in a dynamic state in curvilinear motion.
Examines the kinematic and kinetic information of bodies in a dynamic state in planar motion.

syllabus_topics: Linear and curvilinear motions of particles
Planar motion and kinetics of particles
Kinematics and kinetics of rigid bodies
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan; they are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the university's Senate.
